disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring or attempting to procure a certificate or license by false statement, false information, or fraud.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring or attempting to procure a certificate or license or renewal of a certificate or license pursuant to this act by knowingly making a false statement, submitting false information or refusing to provide complete information in response to a question in an application for certification or licensure or renewal of certification or licensure through any form of fraud or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to meet the minimum qualifications established by this act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to meet the minimum qualifications established by this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Paying or offering valuable consideration to a board member or employee to procure a certificate.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Paying, or offering to pay, any valuable consideration other than provided for by this act to any member or employee of the board to procure a certificate under this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being convicted of or pleading guilty to a crime substantially related to real property appraisal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted of or pleading guilty to a crime which is substantially related to the qualifications, functions and duties of a person developing real property appraisals and communicating real property appraisals to others.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing or omitting an act involving dishonesty, fraud, or misrepresentation for personal benefit or to injure another.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing an act or omitting an act when such performance or omission involves dishonesty, fraud or misrepresentation with intent to substantially benefit the certificateholder or licensee in his profession or with the intent to substantially injure another person.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating standards for development or communication of real property appraisals under this act or FIRREA.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating any of the standards for the development or communication of real property appraisals as required pursuant to this act or the Financial Institutions Reform, Recovery, and Enforcement Act of 1989

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing or refusing without good cause to exercise reasonable diligence in developing, preparing, or communicating an appraisal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing or refusing, without good cause, to exercise reasonable diligence in developing an appraisal, preparing an appraisal report or communicating an appraisal.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligently or incompetently developing, preparing, or communicating an appraisal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Negligently or incompetently developing an appraisal, preparing an appraisal report or communicating an appraisal.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully disregarding or violating any provision of this act or board guidelines or regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully disregarding or violating any of the provisions of this act or the guidelines or regulations of the board for the administration and enforcement of the provisions of this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Accepting an assignment where employment is contingent on a predetermined value conclusion or fee is contingent on opinion/valuation reached.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Accepting an appraisal assignment when the employment itself is contingent upon the appraiser's reporting a predetermined analysis or opinion, or where the fee to be paid for the performance of the appraisal assignment is contingent upon the opinion, conclusion or valuation reached, or upon the consequence resulting from the appraisal assignment.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the confidential nature of records accessed through employment or engagement as an appraiser.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating the confidential nature of records to which the appraiser gained access through employment or engagement as an appraiser.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making fee or compensation contingent upon an award or recovery in any case where the appraisal would affect the amount.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making the fee or compensation contingent upon an award or recovery in any case where the amount of the award or recovery would be affected by the appraisal.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Basing fee or compensation on a percentage of the final estimate of value.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Basing the fee or compensation on a percentage of the final estimate of value.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Contracting for or accepting compensation in the form of a commission, rebate, division of brokerage commissions, or similar form.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Contracting for or accepting compensation for appraisal services in the form of a commission, rebate, division of brokerage commissions or any other similar form.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license or certificate to perform appraisals suspended, revoked, or refused by another state's appraisal authority, or receiving other disciplinary actions.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license or certificate to perform appraisals suspended, revoked or refused by an appraisal licensure or certification authority of another state, territory or country, or receiving other disciplinary actions by the appraisal licensure or certification authority of another state, territory or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice by a federal or state governmental agency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension or revocation of the right to practice by a Federal or State governmental agency.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having been found by a civil court to have performed a fraudulent appraisal.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been found by a civil court of competent jurisdiction to have performed a fraudulent appraisal.

definition_quote.value: A written analysis, opinion or conclusion relating to the nature, quality, value or utility of specified interests in, or aspects of, identified real property, for or in expectation of compensation.
definition_quote.quote: A written analysis, opinion or conclusion relating to the nature, quality, value or utility of specified interests in, or aspects of, identified real property, for or in expectation of compensation.

appraisals required by FIRREA for federally related transactions
methods_authorized.quote: Persons who are certified as residential real estate appraisers and general real estate appraisers under this act shall also have authority to perform real estate appraisals in nonfederally related transactions appropriate to their certification classification.

credential_tiers.quote: There shall be three classes of certified real estate appraisers as follows: (1) Certified residential appraiser ... (2) Certified general appraiser ... (3) Broker/appraiser

federally_related_transaction_scope.quote: To perform appraisals required by the Financial Institutions Reform, Recovery, and Enforcement Act of 1989 ... to be performed by a State-certified or State-licensed real estate appraiser unless that person holds an appropriate, current and valid certificate from the board to perform real estate appraisals.

nonfederally_related_transaction_scope.quote: To perform real estate appraisals in nonfederally related transactions unless that person holds an appropriate, current and valid certificate from the board to perform real estate appraisals.

property_type_scope.quote: Certified general appraiser, which shall consist of those persons applying for and granted certification relating to the appraisal of both residential and nonresidential real property without limitation

trainee_supervision_required.quote: An appraiser trainee shall operate under the direct supervision of one certified residential appraiser or certified general appraiser for the purpose of completing the experience requirement for an appraiser credential in subsection (a).

supervisor_experience_years.quote: The supervisory appraiser shall be in good standing, have at least five years of experience as a certified residential appraiser or certified general appraiser

max_trainees_per_supervisor.quote: shall not supervise more than three appraiser trainees.

temporary_practice_permitted.quote: the board shall recognize on a temporary basis the certification or license of an appraiser issued by another state if: (1) the property to be appraised is part of a federally related transaction; (2) the appraiser's business is of a temporary nature; and (3) the appraiser registers with the board.

multi_state_licensure_reporting_required.quote: Any appraiser certified in this Commonwealth who is also certified or licensed to perform appraisals in any other state, territory or country shall report this information to the board on the biennial renewal application. Any disciplinary action taken in any other state, territory or country shall be reported to the board on the biennial renewal application, or within 90 days of disposition, whichever is sooner.

contingent_fee_prohibited.quote: Accepting an appraisal assignment when the employment itself is contingent upon the appraiser's reporting a predetermined analysis or opinion, or where the fee to be paid for the performance of the appraisal assignment is contingent upon the opinion, conclusion or valuation reached, or upon the consequence resulting from the appraisal assignment.

percentage_fee_prohibited.quote: Basing the fee or compensation on a percentage of the final estimate of value.

commission_split_fee_prohibited.quote: Contracting for or accepting compensation for appraisal services in the form of a commission, rebate, division of brokerage commissions or any other similar form.

qualifying_education_credit_for_prior_co.quote: To the extent permitted pursuant to the Financial Institutions Reform, Recovery, and Enforcement Act of 1989 with regard to certified residential and general appraisers, the board may give credit to an applicant for classroom hours of academic experience successfully completed prior to the board's prescription and definition of subjects pursuant to this subsection.

continuing_education_excluded_topics.quote: No credit shall be given for any course in office management or practice building.

trainee_qualifying_education_counts_towa.quote: any qualifying education completed after the issuance of the license and during the biennial licensure period may also be applied to satisfy the licensed appraiser trainee's continuing education requirements under this subsection.

revocation_reinstatement_waiting_period_.quote: Any person whose certificate or license has been revoked may apply for reinstatement, after a period of at least five years
